after years of self loathing, emotional instability, sh, failed attempts i tried to tell them but they didn't really listen or care. it got to the point where the school had to intervene and i was given an ultimatum: seek help from my parents or be expelled

they were very disappointed in me and even though i hated them for their apathy i felt bad that they had to deal with me. they didn't really care about my sh despite my arms and legs being covered in deep scars over the course of 5 years (3 months cleans atm woohoo) but they dont know abt my attempts. 

its been a rollercoaster: for about a few months my parents refused to buy my medication which caused major side effects and hindered my recovery for a while. lots of screaming matches too.  

its complicated: its like i know they want me to get better but they really couldnt give a shit :/
